notes: NUZU 2.5 - made with Argus 1.0.3. Deal lists, buying guides, membership / subscribe / login / shop pages and headlines with no words of their own are left out; news about Black Friday stays. The site rebuilds every 15 minutes while a refresh run is going (up to 5.5 hours per run). A story found in two sections shows once, with an 'also in' tag. 141 outlets' own feeds (BBC, NPR, Guardian, Al Jazeera, DW, France 24, CBC and more) so their headlines open the article directly; Google News stays as the fallback. The top bar has the same order and look as Party Portal's. The silent video tiles pause while the page is hidden; the one being heard keeps playing. health.json is written each build. Includes 2.3.1 (the heard tile held, TAB/ARGUS full screen, the Argus accent).
